title: Secretary of State of South Dakota

context.text: Incumbent Secretary of State Monae Johnson, a Republican, lost the nomination at the June 27, 2026 Republican state convention to Heather Baxter, who received 59% of delegate votes. Johnson has since endorsed Democratic nominee Terrence Davis.
South Dakota's major parties choose their secretary of state nominees at conventions rather than primaries; Davis and Lesnar are the Democratic and Libertarian nominees.

candidates.name: Heather Baxter
candidates.ballotNote: Defeated incumbent Secretary of State Monae Johnson at the June 27, 2026 Republican convention, with 59% of delegate votes.
candidates.currentRole: South Dakota state representative, District 34 (since January 2025)

priorities.text: Election integrity: build on her sponsoring and voting for election bills and ensure "every vote is counted accurately via paper ballots."
Support robust post-election audits and improved hand-counting methods; require that all counties have the tools to audit cast vote records (she says only 4 of 66 can now).
Reduce fees and regulations for small businesses and advocate for a South Dakota "DOGE" efficiency effort.
Work with legislators on campaign-finance reform and clearer reporting.

statements.quote: I will protect and enforce South Dakota’s proof of citizenship laws
statements.context: On her campaign website's home page

record.text: Co-sponsored state legislation to prohibit the use of automatic tabulating machines to count votes (2025 session); told South Dakota Searchlight she supported it because some counties use outdated software that does not meet federal standards.

candidates.name: Terrence Davis
candidates.ballotNote: Democratic nominee; endorsed by Republican Secretary of State Monae Johnson on September 19, 2026.
candidates.currentRole: Former intake specialist, East River Legal Services

priorities.text: Keep the current tested, audited ballot counters with post-election audits in every county.
Let 16-year-olds pre-register when they get a driver's license, and keep voting close to home in rural counties.
Build privacy protections into voter-registration systems and create an investigative division inside the office to look into fraud.
Rebuild trust through more timely responses to county auditors, the public and the media, and a better website.
Protecting voting rights, including easier access to voting locations.
A statewide database for ballot initiatives and signatures, and reducing government burdens on businesses.

researchNotes: Slate: the South Dakota Secretary of State's official 2026 General Election Candidate List shows Davis (DEM), Lesnar (LIB) and Baxter (REP), matching South Dakota Searchlight. Davis's campaign site and Baxter's site were read in full; Davis's and Lesnar's positions on documentary proof of citizenship were not found. Baxter's tabulator bill number was not located (cited from Searchlight rather than the legislature's site). Mentions of Baxter's 2024 House election and committees come from Ballotpedia.
